planning_notes: Board is authoritative: arduino:avr:uno. Wiring is preserved exactly to A0 (LDR), D9 (PWM LED), D6 (buzzer tone), and D13 (status LED).
No serial reporting or serial command input was specified; serial_channels is empty.

No PWM/ADC scaling, LED inversion mapping, or buzzer beep frequency/duration is encoded in device requests; those thresholds and behaviors belong in the SysML model using sampled A0, elapsed_ms, and the boolean/tone outputs as business logic gates.

Because a tone output is required on D6 and Uno supports it, no Timer1/PWM conflicts are introduced by the request set (PWM is on D9 which is Timer1 on Uno; model duration logic uses elapsed_ms rather than blocking delays).

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: PWM LED brightness (invert: brighter ambient -> dimmer LED)

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer short beep when ambient light is extremely high (>800)
